notConfigured.title: Sign-in is not configured
notConfigured.description: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

login.title: Welcome back
login.lead: Sign in to keep teaching your models.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.lead: Start with a free workspace. You will finish on our secure sign-up page.

callback.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

verify.title: Verify your email first
verify.body: Only users with a verified email can create a workspace. Check your inbox for our verification email, confirm it, then sign in again.

details.name: Workspace name
details.nameHelp: Shown to your team. You can rename it later.
details.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens. It cannot be changed after creation.

slugError.format: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, up to {{max}} characters.

review.owner: You will be the Owner of this workspace and can invite members afterwards.

error.title: Could not create the workspace
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.unverified: Your email is not verified yet. Verify it, then sign in again.
error.conflict: This handle is taken, or an earlier attempt is still running. Go back and change the handle, or try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

notFound.label: Page not found
notFound.title: We could not find that page
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the workspace may not be yours.

error.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
error.notFound: We could not find that. It may have been removed.
error.conflict: That conflicts with the current state. Refresh the page and try again.
error.invalid: Some of the details are not valid. Check them and try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

restore.label: Workspace waiting for deletion
restore.title: {{name}} is scheduled for deletion
restore.body: Restore it to get your workspace back as it was.
restore.bodyMember: Ask an owner of this workspace to restore it.

invite.failedBody: The link may have expired or been used already. Check that you are signed in with the email address that was invited, or ask for a new link.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.emailHelp: They must sign in with this address, and it must be verified.
invite.linkBody: Send this link to {{email}}. It works once and expires in 7 days.
invite.once: We cannot show this link again. Copy it now.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: They lose access to this workspace right away. You can invite them again later.

alone.label: Just you in this workspace
alone.title: It is just you here
alone.body: Invite a teammate to share this workspace.

denied.label: Members are managed by owners and admins
denied.title: Members are managed by owners and admins
denied.body: Ask an owner or admin if you need someone added or removed.

danger.title: Delete workspace
danger.body: Deleting hides this workspace from everyone. You can restore it from the workspace menu until it is removed for good.
danger.confirmBody: Everyone loses access until an owner restores it.
danger.mismatch: That does not match the workspace name.
